node.statement: Let A_R be any extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra. By def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra, its n=1 amplification A_R is an epsilon_R-C*-algebra. The default approximate-unit clause in def-epsilon-cstar-algebra then gives | ||u_{A_R}||-1 | <= epsilon_R. The left-hand side is an absolute value and hence is >=0, so 0<=epsilon_R. Applying this conditional fact after the Stage-3 envelope certifies A_R as extended epsilon_R-C* yields 0<=epsilon_R; together with epsilon_R<=t_3 from node 1.1.1.1, it yields 0<=epsilon_R<=t_3.
